card.name: Capital or lowercase G starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter G or g that begins a new word, or the 'ag' in 'disagreement'. It appears after a space, mostly before words like Gershonites, Gambia, gears, gaskets, and G.I. or G-tube.

modes.label: G starting a word
modes.description: A lone G or g begins a word split into pieces, such as Gambia, Gershonites, gaskets, gorgonians.
